radiusSource: Radius 137.2 +/- 6.6 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, AQ Pup: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 137.2 +/- 6.6 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 95,450,040 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
